_comment: Do-not-translate list. These proper nouns must appear verbatim in every language. Matching is word-boundary, not substring. Enforced by glossary.test.ts. A phrase belongs here only if no identifier form of it (dev_fleet, DEVFLEET) and no legitimate compound spelling (German 'Kiro Crew-Dashboard') appears in the catalogs: the check is a near-miss detector, so it would read those as respellings of the product name.
